description: Institution-level earnings of federally aided undergraduate entrants working and not enrolled, regardless of completion. Reports medians at 6/8/10 years after entry, 6/10-year percentiles, and non-male/male 6-year medians. For graduate program earnings use scorecard_get_programs. years selects API data-file start years (1996–2025), including files without earnings observations. Per-metric availability and official cohort/measurement/dollar context accompany values; unknown metadata stays absent. No re-inflation is performed.

anyOf.description: Base-10 school ID resolving to a positive safe integer; whitespace, leading zeros, plus, decimal, and exponent forms are accepted.

years.description: Optional API data-file start years from 1996–2025 (e.g. [2003, 2011, 2020]); valid files may lack observations. Omit or pass [] for snapshot only.

Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
